summary.en: Houthi missiles have struck Yemen's presidential palace in Aden, killing five officials, and have also hit a Saudi airport. Iran has boosted its air defenses and is shipping LPG and jet fuel despite a US blockade, while also sinking two container ships near the Strait of Hormuz, expanding the threat to regional shipping. US officials are reportedly considering the use of the "mother of all bombs" if fighting resumes, and Trump has ruled out using a nuclear bomb on Iran. The conflict recorded 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
